thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Major: multi-region failover detected — automated traffic-shift initiated from eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 after eu-west healthchecks degraded. Paging on-call.

sam: ack. i'm oncall infra. noticing a bunch of 502/504 from customers geo-routed to eu-west. auto-shift started ~T-3m.

lia: what's the triggered policy? full drain or gradual?

sam: auto-policy = zero-weight-on-failure (fast). That seems to have dumped a lot of sessions to us-east and caused token bucket exhaustion + downstream rate limits.

omar: confirms from network telemetry: route53 health-check marked primary as unhealthy (flapping), but BGP path shows high AS path latency from eu-west PoP to backbone. Provider status shows an "edge fabric instability" event.

dev-ops-bot: attempted mitigation: incremented us-east pool by +25% and started spinning up warm pods in us-east-1 cluster.

nina: customer impact snapshot: ~12% error rate spike across the platform for keys pinned to region=eu-west-1. Dedicated customers in EU saw degraded throughput. Support already seeing tickets.

kevin: recommendation: revert auto-policy to staged-shift, set eu-west weight to 40% (not 0) and set drain timeout to 20s. Also lower DNS TTL to 20s to speed client rebinding. Thoughts?

sam: agree. full-zero made more pain. changing now.

support-bot: Draft message prepared for affected customers: "We are mitigating a regional network event impacting EU region routing. We're shifting traffic gradually to alternate regions. You may see transient errors. We will update in 30 mins." Approve?

lia: approve. send after we confirm weight change.

sam: applied staged weights: eu-west-1 -> 40%, us-east-1 -> +15%, ap-south unchanged. Drain timeout set 20s. TTL set to 20s for service.example.com.

omar: after staged shift, error rate dropped from 18% -> 7% in 4m. However p99 latency in us-east increased and a few pods saturated. We should pre-scale a little more.

dev-ops-bot: autoscaler triggered; additional pods starting. Estimated ready in 90s.

nina: support update sent to top impacted customers. One enterprise account requested temporary region pinning.

kevin: note: our client SDK caches DNS aggressively ignoring TTL for 5m in some versions; might delay failover for certain clients. Need to include note in comms.

ops-lead: action: disable aggressive zeroing policy in runbook and file PR to change default to staged-shift with backoff and provider-signal gating. Assign to sam and lia.

sam: assigned. will open the ticket.

lia: also logging: provider incident INC-2024-EU-EDGE opened — ETA unknown. They report intermittent fabric failures in eu-west-1b. Might be resolved in 30-60m.

kevin: question: did we see any DNS misconfiguration? Could TTL changes worsen client behavior?

sam: we reduced TTL to 20s during mitigation; previous TTL was 300s. Risk is minimal; main delay is client-side caching.

omar: routing note: internal healthchecks were using a single PoP vantage point that was affected. Need to diversify health-checkers across PoPs to avoid false positives. I'll add as postmortem item.

nina: running quick customer impact tally: 24 accounts had >1% errors; 4 are on dedicated infra in eu-west. Logging all for follow-up.

support-bot: created support tickets for the 4 dedicated accounts and linked to internal incident.

kevin: operational mitigation: increase circuit breaker thresholds to reduce upstream 429/503 cascades while capacity warms. Lower retry window on clients to avoid retry storms.

sam: applied temporary circuit breaker adjustments and lowered gateway retries from 5 -> 3 for 15m.

lia: handoff: i'm going off-call in 25m. sam will be primary after that. sam?

sam: confirmed. i'll take over.

dev-ops-bot: new pods healthy; CPU normalized. p95 latency decreasing.

omar: provider reports partial fabric reroute in progress. Some packet loss persists but much reduced.

nina: support update: customers acknowledged, one asked for ETA; we linked provider status and recommended pinning to a healthy region if urgent.

kevin: post-incident action list (brief): 1) change zero-weight policy, 2) diversify healthcheck PoPs, 3) client SDK caching awareness, 4) DNS-override playbook, 5) add provider network signal to gating logic. Assign owners.

ops-lead: I'll create the postmortem and assign owners. include timeline and metrics. Also schedule a runbook test in staging to exercise staged-shift.

incident-bot: Incident state -> monitoring. Will reopen thread if automated detection triggers.

sam: final update: monitoring stable, error rate back to baseline ~1.2%, affected accounts down to 2 with reduced impact. closing watch in 30m.

incident-bot: Thread will be archived for updates.
